{{Quote|Trade Federation forces dead ahead. Protect the settlement.|Naboo commando to Lt. [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]]|<ref name="BfN" />}}
This '''attack''' was launched by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] after receiving intelligence about a [[Trade Federation Research Station]]. The Research Station was working on creating a new type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]. A commando raid captured the research station, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] provided air support while the data were downloaded. After Federation reinforcements joined the battle, the commandos were evacuated.

==Prelude==
After the invasion of their home [[Planet/Legends|planet]],<ref name="timeline" /> the forces of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] kept on their guard and watched the actions of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. They launched an attack on a [[Trade Federation Research Station|research station]] to uncover its secrets.<ref name="BfN" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|I have enemy fighters on my scope.|Lt. Sykes|<ref name="BfN" />}}
After the Naboo [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] captured the facility, the Trade Federation launched reinforcements in the form of a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], the sole Naboo [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], engaged the initial Federation forces while flying his [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]].<ref name="BfN" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
He strafed the six approaching [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], thinning their ranks. The [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] was destroyed before it could disgorge its complement of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. As the data theft continued, the Trade Federation continued to harass the Naboo defenders using [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPS]] and more [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Sykes destroyed many forces, but eventually the superior numbers took their toll and the Research Station began to crumble, even with [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turret]] defenses.<ref name="BfN" />
{{Endgame}}

When the data completed its download, the commandos called for their [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to evacuate them. The ship landed on the base as the soldiers climbed aboard. With the survivors gathered together, the ship lifted off. A number of droid starfighters began to chase the escaping cruiser, but Sykes escorted the ship to a safe distance.<ref name="BfN" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The commandos uncovered evidence of new advanced battle droid technology. We must monitor this new development vigilantly...|The post-battle briefing given to Lt. Sykes|<ref name="BfN" />}}
When Naboo technicians analyzed the data, they discovered the Trade Federation was creating a new type of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]]. They knew they had to keep track of further developments.<ref name="BfN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack is the first bonus mission of the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', unlocked through the use of cheat codes or by achieving bronze medals on all regular campaign missions. It is not necessary to destroy all Trade Federation forces, but this article assumes the player did so. There is a [[security hangar]] near the facility to change starfighters.
